svg.title: Typed source frontiers
svg.desc: Two kernel-checked authored examples. A dependent input type refers to an earlier parameter. A fragment beneath a lambda becomes a function input. Fixed original dependent types, reversed order and a fixed ambient let are rejected. Original source positions remain distinct from computed parameter positions.

svg.text: New parameters have an ordered telescope; the original source context Γ stays fixed.
The local n is supplied at the original scope.
Three rejected candidates: fixed original input types, reversed parameter order, and a fixed ambient-let alias.
Solid arrows: value flow in the computed term. Dashed arrow: a reference in a computed parameter type.
Authored controls: 8 accepted functions, 3 kernel rejections. Source recovery and ordered provenance are checked separately.
